title: Directed Social Regard: Surfacing Targeted Advocacy, Opposition, Aid, Harms, and Victimization in Online Media

bias_targets.methodology: Applying norm-based data augmentation via counterfactual substitution of nation names and geopolitical entities (e.g., Russia, China, Nigeria) to evaluate and mitigate the model's spurious, context-free associations of negative or positive regard.

Aggregating span-level multi-dimensional sentiment (DSR) scores for male and female nouns/pronouns and computing log odds ratios to evaluate gender-directed opposition, harm, and victimization across different social media corpora (e.g., Manosphere, #MeToo).
